verdict.line: You lose isolated trades whenever Cho'Gath opens with Q (Rupture) from outside your range, but the lane holds even overall if you survive to level 6 and lean on your jungler for all-ins, per the 44% head-to-head over 125 games.

brief.thesis: Cho'Gath's Q (Rupture) reaches 950 range against your Q (Cryptic Gaze)'s 550, so he can knock you up and slow you before you're ever close enough to stun back. His passive Carnivore also heals him on every kill, giving him better sustained lane presence, which is exactly why OP.GG's own tip is to avoid getting hit by his Q and to call your jungler once you hit 6 rather than force solo kills.

theirWindow.what: Rupture knocks you up and slows you, and he'll often chain W (Feral Scream) to silence you out of your Q (Cryptic Gaze) while his passive E (Vorpal Spikes) procs free damage on every auto; disengage rather than trading face-up here.

yourWindow.what: Close the gap and open with your own Q (Cryptic Gaze) to stun him from 550 range, toggle on E (Enrage) for the attack damage, and shield up with W (Death's Caress) so his only answer left is E (Vorpal Spikes) autos, which you out-sustain.

powerCurve.note: Rupture pokes from range you can't answer
R (Cannibalism) sustain offsets his Feast threat
Heartsteel/Hollow Radiance HP closes the gap

start.why: Both of his damage sources, Q (Rupture) and W (Feral Scream), are magic; the flat magic resist and sustain on Doran's Helm directly answers that poke better than Doran's Shield does here.

boots.why: Tenacity cuts the slow from Rupture and the magic resist blunts both his Q and W, the two abilities you're told to respect most.

core.why: Scales your max health directly, which stacks with E (Enrage)'s permanent HP gain on kills to out-scale his Feast stacking.
Health and resistances that let you actually stand in his poke range to farm instead of conceding lane.
More effective health against a champion whose kit is entirely magic damage, finishing the all-in-friendly bruiser core.

situational.when: you need stronger wave clear to avoid getting zoned off farm by his Q poke
he's grouping with healers or leaning on lifesteal/on-hit to out-sustain your trades
you need early grievous wounds to cut into his Carnivore passive healing

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on autos for free sustained damage and healing in extended trades, which is exactly what you need since OP.GG flags his superior lane sustain as the core problem here.

summoners.why: The highest-pick, highest-winrate combo (87.4% pick, 47.6% win) because this is a scaling matchup where you need to reset off bad trades, hold wave with Teleport, and return with your item spikes rather than force early fights you lose.

playing.title: Respect the 950 range gap
playing.detail: Cho'Gath's Q (Rupture) outranges your Q (Cryptic Gaze) by 400 units; don't walk up to farm without W (Death's Caress) active, or you eat free poke you can't trade back.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed or spent Rupture
playing.detail: Q (Rupture) is on a 9-second cooldown; the instant it's down, close with your own Q (Cryptic Gaze) stun and flip on E (Enrage) to trade while he has no answer but autos.

playing.title: Back off after Feral Scream
playing.detail: W (Feral Scream) silences you at 300 range and his passive E (Vorpal Spikes) procs on every auto that follows; disengage rather than continuing to trade blind through the silence.

playing.title: Toggle Enrage only on committed trades
playing.detail: E (Enrage) burns your own health per attack, so only activate it when you're shielded or he's already stunned, not into poke you can't answer.

playing.title: Save Cannibalism for all-ins, not pokes
playing.detail: R (Cannibalism) is a 90-second cooldown that grants lifesteal and attack speed; hold it for a committed extended fight post-6, not to answer a single Rupture.

playing.title: Group before forcing fights after 6
playing.detail: His R (Feast) is a 60-second-cooldown true-damage execute that grows him on every kill; since solo-kill odds favor him, call your jungler for 2v1s instead of forcing 1v1 all-ins.

playing.title: Farm through early levels, don't force it
playing.detail: The lane is even overall (44% in 125 games) but weighted against you levels 1-5; prioritize safe CS with W (Death's Caress) shield absorption over contesting trades you can't win yet.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, runes, summoner spells, boots, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from current-patch OP.GG data (9,522 Sion games in this lane, 125 head-to-head vs Cho'Gath); the trade timings, cooldown windows, and tactical reasoning are my own analysis layered on top of those numbers.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with (Q). As he has better lane sustain, focus on using your skills to contest and farm lane while calling your jungler after you reach level 6.
